name: synara-bot
description: SYNARA Bot is the core backend service powering the SYNARA ecosystem. This repository contains the infrastructure and automation pipeline responsible for Discord monitoring, AI-assisted response generation, event handling, and real-time community interaction.   The system is designed to run on Railway and acts as the bridge between Discord activity and the SYNARA personality framework.   --- ## 👤 Contributors - Tango Hunter --- ## Features * Real-time Discord monitoring   * AI-generated contextual responses   * Personality-driven interaction system   * Event-based automation pipeline   * Modular bot architecture   * Railway deployment support   * Environment-based configuration   * Scalable service structure   * Logging and diagnostic support   * Future-ready integration support
